answer: Each identity monthly must forge one key-seeded cedar-fired clasp at a registered forge: its seed sets alloy ratios and 14 hammer facets, a smith logs temperatures with a quill-signed heat sheet, and an independent lab assays composition and facet depths within 3%. Mismatch or a reused clasp revokes the slot. One clasp takes 5 skilled hours plus $45 assay and $30 metal, so 1,000 Sybils need 5,000 smith-hours and $75,000 monthly with no copying shortcut; trade-off: forge capacity caps admission at about 30 per day.
